subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The wind farm taught students that solutions should not be judged by whether they are perfect.”?
options: They should be judged by how responsibly they reduce harm.
Once measured, it becomes harder to ignore and easier to reduce.
Rules can limit harm and make better conversation possible.
Sometimes people improve faster when they are not afraid of being judged.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The wind farm taught students that solutions should not be judged by whether they are perfect. They should be judged by how…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Once measured, it becomes harder to ignore and easier to reduce.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Rules can limit harm and make better conversation possible.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes people improve faster when they are not afraid of being judged.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The wind farm taught students that solutions should not be judged by whether they are perfect. They should be judged by how responsibly they…」，答案為「They should be judged by how responsibly they reduce harm.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They should be judged by how responsibly they reduce harm.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
